title: Beat 295 - Return
description: A woman in a long dark coat and a man in a military uniform stand in an ornate, decaying room, clasping hands while a long film strip bearing silhouetted figures wraps around them. The floor is littered with film reels, tangled film strips, a film canister, and scattered photographs beneath dramatic beams of light from a large arched window.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene in an ornate decaying classical room with peeling frescoes. A woman in a long black vintage coat and a man in a WWII-era German military uniform stand facing each other, holding hands. A long cinematic film strip with silhouetted figures curves around their bodies. The floor is covered with spilled film reels, tangled 35mm film, old photographs and film canisters. Beams of cinematic light pour through a large arched window at dusk, painterly style with rich textures and moody atmosphere
